statement: The exact central quotient E=Bhat/[Nhat,Bhat] has order1152 and central kernel C2 over Q. Its kernel L is free of rank193, M maps onto the central C2, and M-plus=L intersect Fhat-prime has index2 in M. The joint all-Fermat base and every finite index are explicit. The full relative-prime product on M-plus maps onto the D47 source, with unchanged relative-two factor and exact projection kernel equal to the product, over odd p, of ker((M-plus)^(p) to M^(p)). The actual h fixes the enlarged base pointwise. Its two-primary action spliced with odd-primary identities extends the entire D47 action and parameter; an explicit coprime centralizer correction of the r-conjugator and compatible lifts of the s-conjugator preserve every retained CM and Fermat coordinate. The new finite mixed quotient J3=Bhat/(L-prime L^3) has order1152 times3^193. Its exact maximal common marked quotient with D47 is E times_Q G3, of order1152 times3^97; the old full source kernel has exact image C3^96 in J3, and the new kernel has trivial image. The new J3 action is identity and agrees on the whole common quotient. The remaining full source kernel still has exact A7 image under the marked S7 source.
